scope: Account, profile, onboarding, local notifications, settings, Android import and iOS platform audit. These are semantic review scopes, not a claim that every feature was exercised on a device. Shared large files are explicitly partial. Full structural declarations and hashes belong to source-index.json.

Replay from settings does not reset real onboarding completion or user progress.

Stable event identity,35-day ledger retention and12-hour planning catch-up after quiet deferral; RN native daily recurrence is a documented platform adaptation.

Local switch, daily and extra times, plan switch, quiet hours, permission/system links, remote category/per-group controls and normalized time input.
Legacy entry initializes the notification coordinator; RN registers native daily recurring alarms.
Compatibility planning worker, bounded retries and scheduler/cancel hooks; RN reconciles keyed native schedules.

limits: Kotlin test classes appear in the root structural index; this inventory does not claim they were executed or all semantically reviewed.
Shared UI/theme/brand/compatibility UserInfo files were reviewed by the independent reviewer, not this scope.
Native iOS build, signed entitlements, APNs delivery and physical-device behavior still require the release/device checklist.
Daily recurring notifications are owned by the OS; there is no added app-level daily catch-up that might replay an OS-delivered notification.
